articles.title: Strategy's STRC preferred stock hits a record low below par
articles.snippet: The slide has paused the above-par share sales Strategy uses to fund bitcoin purchases, and it is the same stock whose dividends forced the company's first BTC sale this month.

articles.title: Florida man pleads guilty for promoting $1.8B ‘HyperFund’ crypto fraud
articles.snippet: Rodney “Bitcoin Rodney” Burton faces a maximum sentence of five years in federal prison for conspiracy to operate an unlicensed money transmitting business.

articles.title: Ireland Tightens Crypto Safeguards in New Financial Crime Action Plan
articles.snippet: A new National Risk Assessment names crypto-asset misuse among Ireland's top threats, as a 30-point plan tightens checks on crypto funds.

articles.title: SpaceX Surge Could Be Worth Billions for FTX—Will Creditors Benefit?
articles.snippet: Defunct crypto exchange FTX gained exposure to SpaceX in 2022, and the rocket-maker’s post-IPO rally has lifted hopes among creditors.
